adapt: change to suit a new situation
turning point: a time when an important change happens
look back on: think about something that happened in the past
regret: feel sorry about something you did
gradually: slowly, over a period of time
memorable: easy to remember because it is special
make a big decision: choose what to do about something important
take a risk: do something that may have a bad result
keep in touch: continue to talk or write to someone
make progress: improve or move closer to a goal
ambition: something important you hope to do
career: the work you do during your life
deadline: the latest time to finish something
apply: ask officially for a job, place or course
look forward to: feel happy about something that will happen
determined: ready to keep trying to reach a goal
work towards: take steps to reach a goal
set a goal: choose something you want to achieve
meet a deadline: finish something by the required time
get on with: have a good relationship with someone
catch up (with): share news with someone you have not seen recently
routine: the things you usually do in the same way
rely on: trust someone to help or do something
misunderstanding: a situation where someone understands something wrongly
invite (someone) round: ask someone to visit your home
awkward (situation): a situation that makes you feel uncomfortable
politely: in a way that shows respect for other people
keep a promise: do what you said you would do
pop round: visit someone for a short time
tradition: a way of doing something that continues over time
custom: something people in a place usually do
destination: the place someone is travelling to
welcoming: friendly and making people feel comfortable
local: from or connected with a particular place
take a guided tour: visit a place with a person who explains it
try the local food: eat food that is typical of the area
travel light: travel with only a small amount of luggage
stop overnight: stay somewhere for one night during a journey
miss a connection: arrive too late to catch the next bus, train or flight
break your journey: stop for a rest during a long journey
